records.source: Oh, a stranger! My name's Vincent.#$b#Momma says not to talk to strangers... But you seem okay.
records.translation: 喔，是陌生人！我叫文森特。#$b#媽媽說不可以跟陌生人說話……但你好像沒關係。

records.source: Is that a birthday present? Can I open it now?#$b#Oh, wow! This is exactly what I wanted! Yayayaya!$h
records.translation: 那是生日禮物嗎？我現在可以打開嗎？#$b#喔，哇！這正是我想要的！耶耶耶耶！$h

records.source: A birthday present? Oh... this isn't very fun.$s
records.translation: 生日禮物？喔……這個不太好玩。$s

records.source: Wow! It's so sweet! Mmmmm....
records.translation: 哇！好甜喔！嗯嗯嗯……

records.source: *Squish* *squish* ... Ewww! Can I have it? Can I have it? Yaaay!$h
records.translation: *捏捏* *捏捏*……噁！可以給我嗎？可以給我嗎？耶！$h

records.source: Mom! I wanna go outside and play!%noturn
records.translation: 媽媽！我想出去玩！%noturn

records.source: %Vincent is covered in moss.
records.translation: %Vincent身上沾滿了苔蘚。

records.source: *sniff*... what is this? It smells awful... Mommmm!!!$s
records.translation: *聞聞*……這是什麼？聞起來好難聞……媽——媽！！！$s

records.source: That was fun! I wanna be a boat captain some day!
records.translation: 太好玩了！我以後想當船長！

records.source: I wanna come back soon!
records.translation: 我想趕快再來！

records.source: I wanna see a shark!$h
records.translation: 我想看鯊魚！$h

records.source: Don't take my Sammy away!$s
records.translation: 不要把我的山姆哥哥帶走！$s

records.source: If you look close, you can see little bugs jumping out of the sand.$h
records.translation: 仔細看的話，可以看見小蟲子從沙子裡跳出來。$h

records.source: Oooh! Nice find!#$b#Mom wouldn't let me keep him, though...$s
records.translation: 喔——！找得好！#$b#可是媽媽不會讓我留下牠……$s

records.source: I wanna be just like my big brother when I grow up!$h#$e#Okay! Bye!
records.translation: 長大後，我想變得跟哥哥一模一樣！$h#$e#好啦！再見！

records.source: $d kent#I'm glad Dad's back... but he's different than I remember...$s|Dad's not around much... I miss playing with him.$s
records.translation: $d kent#爸爸回來了，我很高興……可是他跟我記得的不一樣……$s|爸爸常常不在……我想念跟他一起玩的時候。$s

records.source: *sigh*... Mom won't let me have any more gummies today.$s
records.translation: *嘆氣*……媽媽今天不准我再吃軟糖了。$s

records.source: Can you keep a secret, mister?^Can you keep a secret, miss?$u#$b#I wanna marry Miss Penny when I grow up.#$e#Just don't tell her, okay?$u
records.translation: 叔叔，你能保守祕密嗎？^姊姊，你能保守祕密嗎？$u#$b#我長大後想跟潘妮老師結婚。#$e#不要告訴她，好嗎？$u

records.source: I wanna look for bugs, but Mom gets mad when I'm all dirty.$u#$b#It's a tough choice.
records.translation: 我想去找蟲子，但全身弄髒時媽媽會生氣。$u#$b#真難選。

records.source: I'm hungry... where's Mom?$s
records.translation: 我肚子餓了……媽媽在哪裡？$s

records.source: You're not as boring as most grown-ups!
records.translation: 你不像大多數大人那麼無聊！

records.source: #$c .3#Ew, it's boiled beet night again...$s#$e#Oh no... Mom's making lentil soup tonight.$s
records.translation: #$c .3#噁，今晚又要吃水煮甜菜……$s#$e#喔不……媽媽今晚要煮扁豆湯。$s

records.source: Dad's coming back soon!#$b#I hope he brings me some toys.$u
records.translation: 爸爸很快就要回來了！#$b#希望他會帶些玩具給我。$u

records.source: Miss Penny makes me read a new book every week.$s#$b#At least she lets me pick them, sometimes!
records.translation: 潘妮老師每星期都要我讀一本新書。$s#$b#至少她偶爾會讓我自己挑！

records.source: $d kent#Dad seems weird since he came back. I wonder what happened to him?$s#$b#He doesn't play with me anymore.$s|I wonder if Dad will ever come home...$s
records.translation: $d kent#爸爸回來後變得怪怪的。不知道他發生了什麼事？$s#$b#他再也不跟我玩了。$s|不知道爸爸會不會回家……$s

records.source: Hi there, mister!^Hi there, miss.
records.translation: 叔叔，你好！^姊姊，你好！

records.source: Hi Uncle @!^Hi Auntie @!#$e#Don't tell Mom... but you're my favorite grown-up.$h
records.translation: @叔叔好！^@阿姨好！#$e#別告訴媽媽……但你是我最喜歡的大人。$h
